5. During survey under the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950, 66 decimals instead of 70 decimals was equally recorded in their names in SA khatian Nos. 197 and 196 respectively. At the time of RS survey, 33 decimals was similarly recorded in the name of each of them in RS khatian Nos. 202 and 225 respectively. 

 15. By a registered deed of sale being No. 4030 dated 24-9-1946 said Premtosh Chandra Ghosh and Bimal Chandra Ghosh transferred 70 decimals of land to Sheikh Hasenuddin. The original deed of Sheik Hasenuddin was adduced and marked Exhibit 4. After the death of Sheikh Hasenuddin, his heirs Samiruddin and others by two deeds being No. 6266 and 6268 dated 12-9-1955 transferred 70 decimals of land to Obaidul Islam and his wife Gulshan Begum and delivered possession. Original deeds were adduced and marked Exhibits 5 and 5(ka). During survey under the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 the suit land was recorded equally in SA khatian Nos. 196 and 197 in the name of his father and mother, Exhibit 7 and 7(ka). Similarly, RS khatian Nos. 202 and 225, 7(kha) and 7(ga) were also prepared in the names of his parents. In the RS khatian a road was shown wrongly. Consequently, his father filed two written objections, which were accepted and mistake was corrected vide Exhibits 9 series. 

 49. We find that the suit land was already recorded in the names of original plaintiff Obaidul Islam and his wife Gulshan Begum during survey under the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 in plot Nos. 298/302 and 298/303 appertaining to SA khatian Nos. 196 and 197. Such record of rights was published some time in 1964. On the basis of such record of rights the plaintiff possessed the suit land exclusively on payment of rents on proper receipt Exhibit 8 series. Similarly, under the RS survey the suit land was again recorded in the names of Obaidul Islam and his wife Gulshan Begum in RS plot Nos. 1207, 1208 and 1209 appertaining to RS khatian Nos. 202 and 225 and RS record of rights was published in 1980s.
